name: Amari Isora
source:
"It's fine. Actually, you're more than welcome. We need more cute girls!"

A temporary chef working at the Fuurin Cafe. He was specifically chosen for the job a few weeks ago. His skills surpass those of his predecessor.

…At least, that’s what Yuki Hirasaka says. While he has already obtained his chef license, he remains ambitious, continuing his training and studying international culinary techniques.

He’s first and foremost a patissier and strives to be the very best in the world.
